label: Bible Study
prompt: Beloved, if God so loved us, we _____ also to love one another.
verse: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
note: If God loved like that, John says, the obligation is obvious.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the _____ that is higher than I.
verse: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
note: From the end of the earth, heart overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

label: Sunday School
prompt: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the _____ to pray about the sixth hour:
verse: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
note: Peter went up on the housetop to pray, got hungry, and received a vision that was all about food.

label: Deep Water
prompt: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this _____ among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verse: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
note: A mystery in Paul isn't a puzzle but a secret now told: Christ living in Gentile believers.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him _____ that taketh his name in vain.
verse: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
note: The third commandment carries a warning label: the LORD will not hold him 'guiltless' who takes his name in vain.
